reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, single and ranged amounts via getRangedAmount.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-implemented; the mapper calls the shared helper.

placement.why: The derived field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API mapping layer, and the update handler explicitly ignores it as read-only.

scope.why: Only the API type, mapper, update-handler skip, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the scheduled-amount rule flows automatically to the API field.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the API field delegates to the shared helper.
